candidates.requirement: Exercise the supported pre-parse operation that sets an explicit 16-byte hash salt for the parsers this target creates and parses.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates root and external parsers; each ParseOneInput calls XML_SetHashSalt before XML_Parse.
candidates.failure_condition: For any target input, the explicit setter is never called. The invoked legacy setter writes zero to the first 64-bit key half, so it cannot supply an explicit 16-byte key with a nonzero first half.
candidates.alternative_paths: Automatic generation may create a full-width key when the salt remains unset, but it does not exercise caller-supplied 16-byte entropy. Child parsers inherit the parent's salt and are passed through the same legacy setter; neither route is equivalent.
